data.description_en:
HUMMUS 🥙

Product type: Ready-to-eat refrigerated food ❄️
Net weight: 200g ⚖️
Origin: Guangzhou, China 🌍

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 🧾

Hummus is a classic Middle Eastern chickpea dip known for its smooth texture and savory depth.

This version is made fresh in our kitchen as a simple, everyday staple.

Creamy without being heavy, rich yet balanced, built for real meals.

No tricks. No fine print. Just a plant-based essential, the Roots way.

WHY PEOPLE ENJOY IT 🌾

Made from chickpeas and sesame, hummus naturally contains plant protein and is commonly used as part of everyday meals.

Its savory, filling character makes it easy to pair with vegetables, breads, and grains.

Designed to sit on the plate — not stand alone — as a practical, food-first choice.

INGREDIENTS 🌱

Chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, spices, citric acid, coriander (topping only)

CONTAINS / MAY CONTAIN ⚠️

Contains: Sesame (tahini), Legumes (chickpeas)
May contain traces of: Nuts, Soy, Gluten

HOW TO EAT 🍽️

Ready to eat.

Enjoy with crackers, pita bread, fresh vegetables, or as a simple side with meals.

STORAGE & SHELF LIFE ❄️

Storage: Keep refrigerated at 0–4°C at all times
Shelf life: See packaging

NUTRITION (PER SERVING 30G ≈ 2 TABLESPOONS) 🧮

Energy 38kcal
Protein 2.4g
Fat 2.9g
Carbohydrate 2.5g

INTENDED USE / NOTES 📌

Plant-based product 🌿
Not suitable for individuals allergic to sesame or chickpeas
data.description_cn:
鹰嘴豆泥 🥙

产品类型：即食冷藏食品 ❄️
净含量：200g ⚖️
产地：中国广州 🌍

产品描述 🧾

鹰嘴豆泥是一款源自中东的经典鹰嘴豆蘸酱，以顺滑的口感和自然的咸香风味著称。

本产品在本店厨房新鲜制作，作为一款日常可食用的基础食品。

口感细腻但不厚重，风味浓郁却不过分，是为真实餐食而存在。

不玩花活，不搞套路，这是 Roots 所坚持的植物性食品。

为什么人们常吃它 🌾

鹰嘴豆泥由鹰嘴豆与芝麻制成，天然含有植物性蛋白，常作为日常饮食的一部分。

风味扎实，口感饱满，适合与蔬菜、面饼和谷物搭配食用。

它不是主角，而是餐盘中实用、可靠的一部分。

配料表 🌱

鹰嘴豆、芝麻酱、柠檬汁、橄榄油、食用盐、香辛料、柠檬酸、芫荽（仅用于表面点缀）

致敏原信息 ⚠️

含有：芝麻制品（芝麻酱）、豆类（鹰嘴豆）
可能含有微量：坚果、大豆、麸质

食用方式 🍽️

开封即食。

可搭配饼干、皮塔饼、新鲜蔬菜，或作为日常餐食的简单配菜。

贮存与保质期 ❄️

贮存条件：全程 0–4°C 冷藏保存
保质期：见包装标示

营养信息（每份30g，约2汤匙）🧮

能量 38kcal
蛋白质 2.4g
脂肪 2.9g
碳水化合物 2.5g

食用提示 📌

植物性食品 🌿
对芝麻或鹰嘴豆过敏者请勿食用
